description: Create a completed Ed25519-signed receipt for an AI agent action with automatic SHA-256 hashing of input and output data. Records model usage, costs, latency, and constraint evaluations. Returns the signed receipt with receipt_id for future reference. Use this as the primary tool for recording agent actions — prefer over create_receipt + complete_receipt for single-step actions.

chain_id.description: Chain identifier for grouping related receipts — auto-generated if not provided

confidence.description: Confidence score for the output quality, 0.0 to 1.0

constraints.description: Constraint definitions to evaluate against this receipt (e.g., max_latency_ms, max_cost_usd, min_confidence)

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime when this receipt expires (e.g., "2026-12-31T23:59:59Z")

input.description: Input data passed to the agent — automatically hashed with SHA-256, raw data is never stored

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata attached to the receipt

output.description: Output produced by the agent — automatically hashed with SHA-256, raw data is never stored

output_summary.description: Human-readable summary of the output for audit purposes (max 500 chars recommended)

parent_receipt_id.description: Parent receipt ID for chaining — links this receipt to a previous step

tags.description: Arbitrary tags for filtering and categorization (e.g., ["production", "critical"])

tokens_in.description: Input tokens consumed by the model

tokens_out.description: Output tokens generated by the model

tool_calls.description: Names of tools called during this action (e.g., ["web_search", "code_exec"])

ttl_ms.description: Time-to-live in milliseconds from now — alternative to expires_at

name: track_action
